item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will reach the coast of southern China tonight. The weather will be cold in the morning tomorrow and over the weekend. It will be fine and dry over the region. It will be very cold in the morning and at night over inland areas, with a rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly early next week. A surge of the northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 09/01 (Thursday)
Wind: Northeast force 4, north force 4 to 5 at night.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cool in the morning. Dry during the day. Temperatures falling appreciably at night.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 45 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
